Chai Flavored Hemp Milk
By: Michelle Finley
Published: Tuesday, December 15, 2009 - 12:06pm

Ingredients




1/4 cup organic shelled hemp seed
scrapings of 1 vanilla bean
1 tiny pinch Celtic sea salt
2 tablespoons honey (optional)
4 cups purified water
hefty dashes of ground cinnamon
hefty dashes of ground cardamom
hefty dashes of ground cloves
hefty dashes of ground ginger

Preparation

1 Place the hemp seed into the blender. 2 Fill the jar to the 1-cup line with purified water. 3 Blend. 4 Add the vanilla bean scrapings, salt, honey (optional), spices (optional), and water up to the 4-cup line. 5 Blend.

About


I created this recipe one day when Juliette requested hemp milk.
